name: quiz-reveal
label: Quiz reveal (question card → countdown → answer)
description: Interview-puzzle / myth-quiz format: question card on screen, a short thinking countdown, then the reveal and the why. Built for comments ('what did you guess?') and rewatches. Health brands: questions are educational, never diagnostic.

structure.name: quiz-reveal
beats: comment prompt: what did you guess?

sync.broll: answer illustration (diagram, demo, product) only after the reveal; ~85:15
sync.fillers: ticking countdown card, freeze on the guess moment, punch-in on the reveal
sync.music: light bed under the question, ticking/riser through the countdown, cut to silence → ding on the reveal
sync.emotion_map: curiosity → suspense (countdown) → surprise/validation → urge to comment
sync.transitions: hard cuts; countdown card as the bridge

references: Aaghaz, 'Edit 10 Videos a Day With Claude' (2026-10-14): interview-puzzle format example
compliance_lock: health: educational questions only, no self-diagnosis quizzes, no superlatives
evidence: format observed in a reference tutorial; values est.
